# @arki/cli

> Typed command-line programs from one `defineCommand({...})`: flags from the input schema, a JSON envelope when piped, text on a terminal, stable exit codes, help that never runs a command. Not a prompt or color library; it does not configure logging.

`main(argv, io)` never exits the process; `run(program)` is the only process boundary.

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/cli`: Typed command-line programs from one `defineCommand`: flags from the input schema, a JSON envelope when piped, stable exit codes. `Cancelled`, `ConfirmationRequired`, `ExitCode`, `InputRequired`, `InvalidInput`, `PreviewUnsupported`, `UnknownCommand`, `defineCli`, `defineCommand`, `group`, `run`; types `AnyCommand`; and 28 more.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- Write no type arguments: input, output and services are inferred.
- Command stdout goes through the envelope or `ui.out`, never `console.log` or `process.stdout`.
- Input keys may not be global flag names (`output`, `json`, `fields`, `quiet`, `dryRun`, `help`, `version`, …).
- Schema defaults apply in validation; the parser never fills them.
- `main` writes nowhere for an `io` field you leave out.
